input: Find a local chess club to join on weekends

gold.taskTitle: Find and Join a Local Weekend Chess Club
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and become a member of a chess club in their area that meets on weekends.

questions.title: What city or neighborhood should the search focus on?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow down local chess club options.

questions.title: What is your current chess skill level?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced player to find a suitable club.

questions.title: Which part of the weekend works best for you?
questions.description: Find out if the user prefers Saturday, Sunday, mornings, afternoons, or evenings.

questions.title: Are you looking for casual play or competitive tournaments?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a relaxed social club or a club with rated tournament play.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to the club?
questions.description: Establish a maximum distance or travel time the user is comfortable with.

questions.title: Do you have a preference for indoor venue type?
questions.description: Find out if the user prefers a dedicated chess club, library, cafe, community center, or any venue.

questions.title: Is a membership fee acceptable, and if so what range?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants a free club or is open to paying membership or session fees.
